mapper.select: SELECT progress_id, student_id, course_id, completed, completion_percentage, time_spent, last_study_time FROM learning_progress WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id), 0) AS total_students, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.completed = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_students, COALESCE( CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(AVG(lp.completion_percentage), 2) END, 0.0) AS average_completion FROM courses c INNER JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.course_id AND e.status = 'active' LEFT JOIN learning_progress lp ON lp.student_id = e.student_id AND lp.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.publish_status = 'published' GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY c.course_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(time_spent), 0) AS total_seconds FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(vp.watched_seconds, 0) AS time_spent FROM video_progress vp WHERE vp.student_id = #{studentId} AND vp.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND vp.updated_at < DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(dp.time_spent, 0) AS time_spent FROM document_progress dp WHERE dp.student_id = #{studentId} AND dp.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND dp.updated_at < DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ) AS progress

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS ( SELECT 0 AS day_offset UNION ALL SELECT day_offset + 1 FROM date_series WHERE day_offset < 365 ), has_study AS ( SELECT DISTINCT DATE(lp.last_study_time) AS study_date FROM learning_progress lp WHERE lp.student_id = #{studentId} AND lp.last_study_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY) AND lp.time_spent > 0 UNION SELECT DISTINCT DATE(vp.updated_at) AS study_date FROM video_progress vp WHERE vp.student_id = #{studentId} AND vp.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY) AND vp.watched_seconds > 0 UNION SELECT DISTINCT DATE(dp.updated_at) AS study_date FROM document_progress dp WHERE dp.student_id = #{studentId} AND dp.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY) AND dp.time_spent > 0 ), consecutive_check AS ( SELECT ds.day_offset, DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL ds.day_offset DAY) AS check_date, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM has_study hs WHERE hs.study_date = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL ds.day_offset DAY)) AS has_activity FROM date_series ds ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS consecutive_days FROM consecutive_check WHERE has_activity = TRUE AND check_date >= ( SELECT MAX(check_date) FROM consecutive_check WHERE has_activity = FALSE )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.course_id) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.status = 'active'
